energy|mountains.definition: How much, and for how long, it was warmer than 18.3 °C: a standard measure of the need for air conditioning.
energy|mountains.why: A direct answer to “Is energy demand changing?”

energy|mountains.label: Heating demand
energy|mountains.definition: How much, and for how long, it was colder than 18.3 °C: a standard measure of the need for heating.
energy|mountains.why: A direct answer to “Is energy demand changing?”

energy|mountains.label: Sunlight reaching the ground
energy|mountains.definition: Solar energy arriving at the surface each day, after clouds and haze.
energy|mountains.why: A direct answer to “Is energy demand changing?”

energy|mountains.label: Wind speed
energy|mountains.definition: Average wind speed ten metres above the ground.
energy|mountains.why: A direct answer to “Is energy demand changing?”

energy|mountains.label: Snow depth
energy|mountains.definition: Average depth of snow lying on the ground.
energy|mountains.why: Mountain water supplies depend on snow, which depends on how often it freezes.
